question:
Anil starts walking from Point K. He walks 30 m towards the east, turns right and walks for 20 m to reach point M. He then takes a left turn, walks for 35 m, takes a right turn and walks for 28 m to reach Point R. He finally takes a right turn and walks for 50 m to reach Point X.

In which direction is Point X with respect to Point K?
solution:
According to given conditions,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5728a35cb69c307e9fe44062610d2a1e13c84672724adfbb9f8784cefa15287e.png] 

Clearly, Point X is to the South-East of Point K.

Hence, ‘**South-East**’ is the correct answer.
